notes: The online rules as data: days, packs and resolution. docs/design/round-resolution.md explains them; this file is what the server reads, so a rules change needs no code change (charter: rules are data; ADR-0002 guardrail).
Cards, incidents, scoring tokens and the release size are shared with the tabletop game and live in deck.json.

cards.note: Which of deck.json's cards are in play online. Only what the simulations exercised is on (the maintainer's call, 2026-09-29); the rest stay in the tabletop deck and come online one small change at a time, once their online rules are precise.

quiet_days.name: Quiet Tuesday
quiet_days.text: Nothing special. Get some work done.

order_options.batch_at_close: All of the day's packs resolve together when the day closes, one whole pack at a time, in a random order drawn from the game's seed (ADR-0003).
order_options.arrival: Each pack resolves the moment it arrives (charter decision 11, superseded; kept for the beta to compare).
